name: opspilot-platform
description: Launch readiness and operational control for complex online events.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,api,worker -c cyan,green,yellow "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:worker"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@opspilot/api && npm run build --workspace=@opspilot/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=@opspilot/api && npm run lint --workspace=@opspilot/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@opspilot/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@opspilot/web
scripts.services:up: docker compose up -d postgres redis minio mailpit
scripts.containers:build: docker build --target api -f apps/api/Dockerfile -t opspilot-api:local . && docker build --target worker -f apps/api/Dockerfile -t opspilot-worker:local . && docker build -f apps/web/Dockerfile -t opspilot-web:local .
